market.question: Named storm forms before hurricane season?

assessment.reasoning: No Atlantic named storms have formed since Dec 4, 2025. ~32 days remain (Apr 29 - May 31). Historical base rate for May preseason named storms is roughly 1 in 5-7 years; 2026 forecasts call for an active season but conditions are not currently flagging imminent development. Probability ~10%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether an early-season subtropical system organizes in the SW Atlantic or Gulf in May.
